Title: A Clothespin Experiment
Content: A student in a Living Environment class designed an experiment to investigate if the number of times a student squeezes a clothespin varies with the hand used. Her hypothesis was that students could squeeze a clothespin more times in a `text(minute)` when they used their dominant hand than when they used their nondominant hand.
During her investigation, she `text(first)` squeezed and released a clothespin as often as possible for `text(20 seconds)` with her dominant hand. She recorded the number of squeezes in a chart.
